title: The spacetime Penrose inequality with charge and original-data rigidity
summary: Under the stated energy, decay, and trapping hypotheses, we prove the sharp charged spacetime Penrose upper-area inequality for one-ended three-dimensional initial data with source-free electric and magnetic fields. The theorem allows arbitrary second fundamental form, nonzero ADM momentum, and disconnected boundary. Writing m for invariant ADM mass, Q for total charge magnitude, and r A for the minimum-enclosing-area radius, the bound is m ≥ Q and $`r_A\le m+\sqrt{m^2-Q^2}`$.
